subject: Veridian Health — VPC hosting discovery & follow-up asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@veridianhealth.com>, Anika Bose <anika.bose@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Veridian health — VPC hosting discovery & follow-up asks

Hi Carlos / Anika —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Key pain & constraints you mentioned:
- Data residency: patient PII and PHI must remain in US regions only; any logging/telemetry needs clear retention and redaction controls.
- Air-gap requirement: certain analytics pipelines will run in an isolated environment with no outbound internet; we need an air-gapped deployment option for that workload.
- Network egress: egress is tightly restricted by permit list; only specific vendor IPs allowed and all outbound must go through a vetted NAT/proxy.
- Procurement and timeline: procurement board meets 12/6; youd like a security packet and an SOW draft by 11/30 to feed the procurement review.

Immediate asks from our side to qualify next steps:
1) Can you share an internal network diagram (VLANs, egress points, proxy/NAT, and any emergency jump/bastion) — I attached a short template to make it easier.
2) Who should we loop in from your security/compliance team? Well prepare SOC 2 artifacts and dependent security docs.
3) Confirm whether deployment must be fully air-gapped (no NTP/CRL access) or whether a controlled egress channel to a vendor proxy is acceptable for updates.
4) Any minimum RTO/RPO or latency targets for inference (e.g., <200ms p95)?

Attachments: redwood-hosting-options.pdf (our private vs dedicated hosting overview), network-diagram-request.xlsx (template for your infra team).

Proposed next steps:
- You: upload network diagram and point security contact (by EOD 11/24 ideally).
- Us: prepare security packet + draft SOW and a concise ops checklist for air-gap deployments (by 11/30).
- Schedule a 60-min technical review with your infra + security to validate compatibility (propose 11/29 or 12/1).

If you want, we can also run a short internal demo showing how Redwoods private control plane behaves in an isolated VPC so security can see audit logs and KMS integration.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@veridianhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Anika Bose <anika.bose@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: IT Security <it-security@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Veridian health — VPC hosting discovery & follow-up asks

Jonas — thanks for the clear note. Agreement on the bullets. Quick responses inline: 

- Data residency: confirmed US-only for PII/PHI. We have a data retention policy that limits logs to 90 days unless required for e-discovery.
- Air-gap: our analytics batch runs must be air-gapped. Real-time inference can live in a VPC with tightly controlled egress through our proxy.
- Egress/IP allowlist: we will need an IP range to add to our firewall policy. Can you provide a stable CIDR block (or small range) for the deployment?
- Timeline: procurement wants SOW + security packet before the 12/6 board. If you can get docs by 11/30 that works.

I attached a first-pass network diagram (note: redactions pending) and a contact for our infra lead, Anika (cc). Also looping in IT Security for any immediate compliance questions.

Carlos
SVP, Platform Operations
Veridian Health

Attachments: veridian-net-diagram-v1.pdf

Subject: Re: Veridian health — VPC hosting discovery & follow-up asks

Carlos — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and the diagram. A few follow-ups to help our architecture and SOW drafting: 

1) CIDR/IP allowlist: our private deployments can use a pair of stable /29s for control and data egress; well provide exact ranges in the SOW but need to confirm whether those can be added to your firewall policy (or whether you prefer us to use your NAT egress IP).
2) Air-gap specifics: for the air-gapped analytics cluster we will need:
   - a vetted update process (signed artifact bundle you can pull via offline media),
   - a defined bastion/jump path for emergency maintenance (we can support a temporary jumpbox model), and
   - explicit confirmation on whether CRL/OCSP checks are blocked so we can adapt cert checks.
3) Authentication & KMS: confirm whether you want Redwood to integrate with your KMS (customer-managed keys) or use a dedicated KMS instance we manage inside the VPC.

Proposed demo + technical validation:
- 45–60 min technical review (ops + security). Options: 11/29 10:00–11:00 PT or 12/1 09:00–10:00 PT. Well include a short runbook for air-gapped patching and a walkthrough of audit logs.

Well start drafting the SOW and security packet today — Laura will own the SOW; Marissa will collate SOC2 artifacts and the deployment checklist.

Jonas
